description: Department of Economic and Community Development- Connecticut Recovery Bridge Loan Program is a dataset listed in State of Connecticut open data portal (data.ct.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Connecticut. This dataset lists all companies funded through the Connecticut Recovery Bridge Loan Program. Information about the bridge loan program can be found here:. Coverage: Connecticut. The portal files it under the category Business. Its tags are small business, economic recovery, decd, covid-19, business assistance. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Economic and Community Development. The portal shows 2025-02-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ct-gov-portal.
